criteria.name: information_gain
criteria.description: Ability of the outcome to discriminate between live explanations or resolve a genuine open question of the project

criteria.name: feasibility
criteria.description: Doable solo by one PhD student on CPU-only + optional Kaggle GPU, no large budget, 1-3 months focused work

criteria.name: rigor_disconfirmability
criteria.description: Measurable outcome, sharp disconfirming observation, pre-registerable analysis, fit with ledger/gate discipline

criteria.name: synergy_relevance
criteria.description: Direct extension, strengthening, or productive challenge of a named finding of the atlas or its experiment

criteria.name: coverage_breadth
criteria.description: Adds geographic, cultural, or genre breadth or de-centres the metropolitan axis (owner's stated priority)
